limitations: Conclusion: actual GPU fraction rises e.g initialPG .0067% ->13.9575%, initialOazis .0977% ->25.0773%, largeMixed .0760% ->6.5403%, loadedOazis4k8.2235% ->51.4648%/8k3.7944% ->50.8586%. This work increase brings adverse CPU cells and no convincing corresponding speed benefit.
CPUoff controls: smallNi -2.61%CPU, PG+.16%, Oazis-1.03%, largeNi-.75%, largeMixed+4.61%; all CPU/wall intervals cross0. Preserve largeMixed uncertainty, not an unconditional no-overhead claim.
RSS adverse intervals: GPUon islesMixed+.43%[+.09,+.95], initialOazis+.41%[+.19,+.67], largeNi+2.00%[+1.62,+2.62]. Other cells nearflat/uncertain; no broad memory benefit.

Cancellation fence counters mean accepted flush, NOT terminal completion. End counters+commits are not a chronological fresh commit after recovery proof. Hardware raw proof separately validates the narrow actual mechanism.

Pending/suspended at exit occurs in several windows; bounded CPU fallback remains exact, but do not claim all jobs recovered. Actual no-error strings/proof-failure/quarantine counters listed per cell. Timing needs final integration/platform qualification independently.

aggregate_runtime_health_qualified.scope: 87 separate measured GPUon processes; cumulative sum is diagnostic repeated workload counting, not unique events across one game. ProofFailure here counts missing terminal proof at quarantine, including recoverable cancellation; it is not a failed output oracle or evidence of corruption.
